notes.title: 🛠️ First Development Update & Introduction
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691123/6fe2367b7d43bf2fe922d3e44250b003fa1960fe.gif"][/img] [b]Welcome, Warlords.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for visiting [i]Yes, My Warlord[/i]! This is our first official development update, and we’re excited to finally share more about the project, where it’s headed, and what you can expect from the upcoming demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]🧠 What [i]Yes, My Warlord[/i] Is All About[/h3][p]You command a monstrous goblin warband clawing its way through a crumbling kingdom. Each week, desperate citizens, strange creatures, and scheming rivals come before your throne with demands, confessions, and absurd requests.
Your job? [b]Decide their fate.[/b]
Will you execute the fool, bless the union, trade your soul, or feed them to the hounds?
Every choice shapes your reputation, your warband, and ultimately, your legacy.[/p][p]If you like games like [i]Yes, Your Grace[/i], [i]Reigns[/i], or [i]Papers, Please[/i], but wish they were a bit darker, we think you’ll enjoy what’s brewing.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 Current Progress & What’s Coming[/h3][p]Here’s where things stand:[/p][list][*][p]🎮 [b]The demo will feature roughly one-third of the full game’s content[/b] — including dozens of choice-driven scenes and events; release date for the demo is currently Q3 of 2025.[/p][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]Major mechanics are already implemented[/b], including faction loyalty, warband management, and progression systems[/p][/*][*][p]🧟‍♂️ [b]One-third of the game’s characters already have their initial animations completed[/b] and will appear in the demo[/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]Full localization for 29 languages is already done[/b] for both the store page and in-game demo[/p][/*][*][p]🔐 The [b]full game will feature multiple difficulty levels[/b], with half a dozen unlockable modes to challenge even the most ruthless warlords[/p][/*][/list]
